description: This file defines a Flutter widget named BannerSSkelton, which constructs a skeleton UI for a banner component, potentially used as a loading placeholder. It conditionally displays a circular skeleton based on the isShowCircle parameter and uses layout widgets like AspectRatio, Stack, Padding, Row, Column, and custom Skeleton and CircleSkeleton widgets.

classes.name: BannerSSkelton
classes.description: A stateless widget representing a skeleton placeholder for a banner component with optional circular element.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget subtree for the skeleton banner, including layout and conditional circle display.
